permissions.name: Raise purchase requisitions
permissions.description: Draft, submit, amend and cancel one's own requisitions, and see them through to delivery.

permissions.name: Approve purchase requisitions
permissions.description: Decide requisitions at the approval steps one is eligible for. Never one's own.

permissions.name: View all procurement
permissions.description: Every plan, requisition, sourcing event, order, receipt and supplier invoice of the organization.

permissions.name: Manage suppliers
permissions.description: Add and change suppliers, their documents and their status (active, inactive, suspended).

permissions.name: Run sourcing
permissions.description: Requests for quotation, proposals and tenders: invite suppliers, record quotations, close and recommend an award.

permissions.name: Evaluate quotations
permissions.description: Record compliance and scores against the criteria set before quotations were opened.

permissions.name: Approve supplier selection
permissions.description: Decide award recommendations at the steps one is eligible for. Never one's own recommendation.

permissions.name: Prepare and issue purchase orders
permissions.description: Draft orders from awards or approved requisitions, issue approved orders, amend, cancel and close them.

permissions.name: Approve purchase orders
permissions.description: Decide orders at the steps one is eligible for. Never an order one prepared.

permissions.name: Receive goods and accept services
permissions.description: Record deliveries, inspection, accepted and rejected quantities, and service completion.

permissions.name: Record supplier invoices
permissions.description: Supplier invoices against orders, and payment made outside Miles Softwares (recorded by hand, not verified).

permissions.name: View procurement reports
permissions.description: Spending tracked by supplier, department and status, and exports.

permissions.name: Manage procurement settings
permissions.description: Approval rules, procurement methods and thresholds, currencies and the Finance connection.

roles.name: Requester
roles.description: Raises requisitions and follows their progress.

roles.name: Department approver
roles.description: Approves requisitions; can also raise them.

roles.name: Procurement officer
roles.description: Runs sourcing, keeps suppliers and prepares purchase orders.

roles.name: Procurement manager
roles.description: Everything an officer does, and approves plans, awards and orders prepared by others.

roles.name: Finance viewer
roles.description: Sees orders, receipts and supplier invoices, and the reports.

roles.name: Procurement administrator
roles.description: Settings, approval rules and the audit trail, with read access to everything.

roles.name: Auditor
roles.description: Reads everything, including the audit trail; changes nothing.

separation_of_duties.description: Procurement refuses approval of one's own requisition (unless settings allow it); one person holding both still removes a check when nobody else does.
Procurement refuses approval of an award by whoever recommended it.
Procurement refuses approval of an order by whoever prepared it.
Whoever places an order should not also confirm its delivery.
